newPatient.title: Ŋlɔ dɔnɔ ƒe ŋkɔ
newPatient.consentText: Ɖe nusita nèle eƒe nyatakakawo dzram ɖo la gɔme na dɔnɔ la le eƒe gbe me, eye be ate ŋu agbe.
newPatient.consentGiven: Dɔnɔ la lɔ̃ be woadzra eƒe lãmesẽ nyatakakawo ɖo.
newPatient.consentPromise: Eƒe nyatakakawo anɔ telefon sia dzi va se ɖe esime woaɖo wo ɖe lãmesẽ dɔwɔƒea le dedie me. Eƒe lãmesẽ dɔwɔlawo ɖeɖeko akpɔ wo.
newPatient.personText: Ŋlɔ nu si dɔnɔ la gblɔ na wò. Ne menya eƒe dzigbezã o la, ŋlɔ eƒe ƒe.
newPatient.placeText: Ale be lãmesẽ dɔwɔla kple dɔyɔƒe si dze nalé ŋku ɖe eŋu.
newPatient.phoneWhy: Mehiã o. Ɖeko na sraɖekpɔ ŋkuɖodzi.
newPatient.nationalIdWhy: Mehiã o. Ɖeko na NHIS dodokpɔ.
newPatient.statement: Míedi be míadzra wò lãmesẽ ŋuti nuŋlɔɖiwo ɖo fon sia dzi, eye míaɖo wo ɖe Ghana Health Service le mɔ dedie dzi, ale be wò lãmesẽdɔwɔlawo nate ŋu akpɔ wò ɖe ŋu. Wò lãmesẽdɔwɔlawo ɖeɖe koe akpɔe. Àte ŋu agblɔ be ao, eye àte ŋu agblɔ na mí be míadzudzɔ ɣesiaɣi. Èlɔ̃a?
newPatient.districtFixed: Patients are registered in your own district.

payments.title: Payments

payments.how: The patient approves on their own phone (MTN MoMo, Telecel Cash or AirtelTigo Money). The call opens once it's paid.

payments.cantCheckNow: The fee couldn't be checked just now. Pull down to refresh, or try again in a minute.

results.empty: Dodokpɔ aɖeke meli haɖe o. Tsɔ dodokpɔ kaba si nèwɔ kpe ɖe eŋu, alo ɖo dɔnɔ la ɖe lab alo X-ray.

category.rapid: Dodokpɔ kaba si wowɔ le afisia

categoryHint.rapid: Malaria RDT, sukli le ʋu me, Hb, fukɔkɔ dodokpɔ: ŋuɖoɖoa le asi fifia.
categoryHint.lab: Ehiã lab: lãmesẽ ƒe xɔ alo kɔdzi.
categoryHint.imaging: Ehiã X-ray alo ultrasound mɔ̃, zi geɖe le nutoa ƒe kɔdzi.

results.sendOutHint: Mɔ̃a meli afisia o. Dɔnɔ la ayi teƒe si wòle.

results.facilityNeeded: Gblɔ afi si dɔnɔ la nayi na dodokpɔa.
results.sendOutNext: Ne dɔnɔ la tsɔ ŋuɖoɖoa va la, ʋu dodokpɔ sia ake eye nàtia "Dodokpɔ ƒe ŋuɖoɖo va" be nàtsɔe akpe ɖe eŋu, eye nàɖe agbalẽa alo film la ƒe foto.

resultHint.lab: Ŋlɔ nu si le agbalẽa dzi, alo nya vevitɔ.
resultHint.imaging: Ŋlɔ nyatakakaa ƒe nuwuwu, ne ele eme.

results.photos: Agbalẽa, nyatakakaa alo film la ƒe fotowo

forecast.title: Kwasiɖa si gbɔna: ŋutilãdzoxɔxɔ ƒe nyagblɔɖi
forecast.intro: Dɔnɔ siwo si ŋutilãdzoxɔxɔ ale le kwasiɖa si gbɔna me, tso nuto ɖesiaɖe ƒe kwasiɖa 8 siwo va yi me. Zãe tsɔ ɖo ɖoɖo na malaria dodokpɔ kple atikewo.
forecast.range: Ɖewohĩ {{low}} va se ɖe {{high}} · tso kwasiɖa {{weeks}} me
forecast.stock_one: Dzra ɖo: malaria RDT {{count}} kple paracetamol na dɔnɔ {{count}}.
forecast.stock_other: Dzra ɖo: malaria RDT {{count}} kple paracetamol na dɔnɔ {{count}}.
forecast.method: Akɔntabubu ƒe mɔ bɔbɔe (Holt's method) le kwasiɖa ɖesiaɖe ƒe xexlẽmewo dzi: mɔfiame na ɖoɖowɔwɔ, menye kakaɖedzi o. Womezãa kwasiɖa siwo me dɔnɔwo mede 5 o.

education.title: Lãmesẽ ŋuti nufiafia
education.intro: Lãmesẽ ŋuti nusɔsrɔ̃ kpuiwo be nàxlẽ, alo nàɖoe kple gbe sesẽ na dɔnɔ alo ƒome.
education.homeHint: Malaria, ʋu ƒe ŋusẽ, fufɔfɔ, ORS kple bubuwo
education.noVoice: Fon sia mate ŋu axlẽ nu kple gbe sesẽ o. Xlẽ nuŋɔŋlɔa na dɔnɔ la.
education.englishOnly: Fifia nusɔsrɔ̃awo le Eŋlisigbe me. Míatsɔ Twi, Eʋe, Hausa kple Dagbani ƒe gbeɖiɖiwo akpe ɖe eŋu ne gbegbɔgblɔ la ƒe tɔwo kpɔe vɔ.
